label: reset unit closes at D1 after a1 reached rare S2, deeper late in episode/repeats
terms: (phase == D1) * (prev_action == 1) * (prev_state == 2) ;; (phase == D1) * (prev_action == 1) * (prev_state == 2) * (ep_trial >= 80) ;; (phase == D1) * (prev_action == 1) * (prev_state == 2) * (tv("action", -2) == 1) * (tv("state", -2) == 2) ;; (phase == D1) * (prev_state == 1) ;; (phase == D1) * (prev_reward == 0) * belief_lo ;; (phase == D2) * last_is("a1 S2 u")
explanation: Raw reset gate r32 sits near 1 (mean 0.97) and its variance beyond timing is almost entirely at D1. Its main drop is at D1 after the previous trial was a1 -> S2 (a rare transition), rewarded or not (about -0.14 to -0.20; the r/u split adds little once the other terms are in). The drop deepens by about -0.07 late in the episode (trials 80+) and by another -0.07 when the trial before was also a1 -> S2, so repeated a1->S2 trials push it down to about 0.45-0.6. At D1 it is slightly higher (+0.026) after the previous trial reached S1. After an unrewarded trial it is lower the more the ideal observer believes S1 is good (graded in belief_lo, -0.015 per logit). At D2 it dips slightly (-0.03) when the last trial was a1 S2 u. GO is nearly flat. Scores (observed only): test R^2 beyond timing 0.64 (dev 0.66). Profile ceilings: all observed 0.69, all 0.75, last trial table 0.61. The earlier model-output explanation (policy decile reference 0.35) is not needed: observed history alone gets about 86% of the all ceiling, so dropping value/policy costs little.

issues: Minor: 'rewarded or not' hides a difference. The profile residuals at D1 are -0.16 after a1 S2 r and -0.203 after a1 S2 u. Adding a separate (prev_reward==0) term on a1->S2 adds nothing (test 0.6436 vs 0.6435), because the belief_lo*(prev_reward==0) term already absorbs it, so the wording is acceptable but loose.

Each claim holds on test. The a1->S2 D1 main term alone scores 0.51. Removing the D2 a1 S2 u term drops the score to 0.635, and removing the belief_lo term drops it to 0.597. The weights match the explanation: -0.136 main, -0.067 at trial 80 and later, -0.070 for a repeated a1->S2, +0.026 after reaching S1, -0.015 per logit of belief_lo after an unrewarded trial, -0.030 at D2.

Some individual windows stay unexplained. Deep drops at D1 (0.45-0.6) also follow a2->S2 unrewarded or a1->S1 trials late in the episode, e.g. t83/t85/t97/t98 actual about 0.55 vs predicted 0.90. Terms for repeated S2 visits barely help (a2->S2 after an earlier S2 visit: 0.651; S2 count over the last 3 trials: 0.647; extra late-episode terms: at most 0.646). These cases are scattered, not a systematic class.
Systematic errors by phase x previous trial are small: at most +0.025 (D1 after a2 S1 r) and -0.022 (D1 after a2 S1 u). Mean error by phase is within 0.004.
The 0.64 test score is close to the 0.69 ceiling for all observed cues. No future, hidden or model-output variables are used, so the observed-only requirement is met.
